answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the horizon hash is checked against the haven checkpoint at intake, the oasis audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. Repeating the trick 50 times costs 16 separate deposits and 14 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
